method: The referenced ImageGen sheet and a localized generated detail were assembled. The detail-edit record identifies their hashes and placement.
request:
Edit the first input image, the selected storyboard. Preserve the existing four landscape panel positions in a 2×2 grid, exact original numbered SHOT_ badges, original palette/compositions and actor likeness. The second input is original family visual reference. Dan blue / left watch, Maya plum with ponytail, Nina teal auburn waves, Leo orange, braided Ella in denim overalls, small Max green. A third reference supplies setting or continuity. In every panel actors and props must follow its specified shot precisely. Keep good panels intact. Apply the following specific changes in the artwork. Work at the original laundry counter with soft gray textile zippered cubes, distinct from cartons. SHOT_049 ONLY Dan, Max and braided Ella; Dan holds exactly one matching folded pair of dark NAVY socks with lighter navy/blue STRIPES below his blue polo collar. Sixth gray cube is completely EMPTY, open on counter; no loose extra clothing in it. SHOT_050 Dan, Nina and Leo; the ONE simple paper luggage tag attached on the handle of the last closed zippered gray bag clearly reads DAN (three letters), no loose socks left. SHOT_051 Maya, Nina and Leo. Exactly SIX separate identical closed soft gray cubes on counter in ONE SINGLE HORIZONTAL ROW, with one small handle tab per cube, physically legible by screen order LEFT to RIGHT: DAN, MAYA, NINA, LEO, ELLA, MAX. No clips, floor cube, open cube, additional seventh cube or loose sock. Leo holds checklist. SHOT_052 Leo Max and Dan; all socks inside closed cubes, no socks or garments anywhere on counter. Leo checks a family sheet with EXACTLY SIX large check boxes in two rows of three. Max counts six naturally with FIVE fingers of one open hand and ONE index finger of the other, curled remaining four fingers. Show each of the two hands clearly. No extra fingers, no floating type or seventh check. No extra cast.
SHOT_049 shows only DAN, MAX, ELLA in LAUNDRY_NOOK. Dan holds the folded navy pair below his polo collar as a visual callback, without wearing, stretching or tying it. Ella laughs and points to the proper cube. End: Pair remains folded and clean; Dan lowers it toward the cube. Existing artwork error: Open sixth cube filled with extra rolled garments; pair in Dan's hands appears solid navy. Fix: Empty cube and keep just one navy-striped pair.
SHOT_050 shows only DAN, NINA, LEO in LAUNDRY_NOOK. Dan writes DAN on the last blank tab, attaches it and packs the navy pair back into the sixth cube. Nina watches him zip it. End: All six cubes labeled and closed; all six pairs packed once; no blank tabs remain. Existing artwork error: Closed cube bears blank front tag after Dan's tagging action. Fix: Attach the single DAN name tab.
SHOT_051 shows only MAYA, NINA, LEO in LAUNDRY_NOOK. Maya and Nina arrange the six closed cubes in name order while Leo checks each handle against the borrowed checklist method. End: Counter order is DAN, MAYA, NINA, LEO, ELLA, MAX; names correspond to unchanged contents. Existing artwork error: Six cubes with blank tags, plus partial additional organizer at lower left. Fix: Limit to six, render each name in source counter order.
SHOT_052 shows only LEO, MAX, DAN in LAUNDRY_NOOK. Leo marks six pair-check boxes on the family sorting sheet; Max counts on his fingers while every cube stays closed. End: Family sheet records six pairs, twelve socks; no inventory has been added. Existing artwork error: Loose navy socks reappear after packing; Max holds up seven fingers and checklist has five boxes. Fix: Keep socks packed, use six checkboxes, show six-count gesture.
